rules.rationale: Halogen-dominated compositions are strongly ionic insulators with deep valence bands, giving the widest measured gaps.
d0/sp main-group oxides lack mid-gap d states, so the O 2p to cation s separation stays large.
Low mean Z means compact valence orbitals, weak spin-orbit coupling, and larger bonding-antibonding splitting.
Pnictides are mostly covalent small-gap semiconductors or semimetals, so they sit near the low end of the pool.

skill.hypothesis: Ranking by ionicity and d-shell closure recovers wide-gap insulators and transfers best when the pool is dominated by main-group oxides and halides; it degrades if narrow-gap mixed-valence or defect-dominated oxides are numerous.
